name: lineage
description: Per-change provenance — answers "why does this line exist?". Records session/turn metadata plus a secret-redacted, size-capped snippet for every Edit/Write/MultiEdit, and for each file a Bash command changes, at PostToolUse into a per-project change ledger, then traces a file or line back to the change that introduced it by joining records to the transcripts historian preserves. Emits lineage.* events for audit. Builds on the Onlooker ecosystem plugin.
